description: This Java source file defines the GatewayWebsocketSessionExpiredException class, a custom unchecked exception indicating that a websocket session has expired due to an expired JWT. It includes static factory methods, a builder pattern implementation, and metadata annotations related to exception handling and JSON parsing.
